premises.text: Africa suffers from a shortage of developers, impacting its digital economy
premises.evidence_span: Africa suffers from what I would love to call SOD, shortage of developers, the real architects of this digital economy.

premises.text: Less than 1% of African school children leave school with basic knowledge of computer science
premises.evidence_span: Less than 1% of African school children leave school with basic knowledge of computer science.

premises.text: Children need to become creators and innovators of technology, not just consumers
premises.evidence_span: These children need not only be passive consumers of technology, but also become creators and innovators of it.

premises.text: Coding is essential for children to prosper in a tech-driven world
premises.evidence_span: coding would play a huge role in helping them prosper in this tech-driven, rapidly changing world.

premises.text: B-Block is a gamified programming learning app for kids
premises.evidence_span: B-Block is a gamified programming learning app for kids.

premises.text: The app teaches programming through game puzzles and animated characters
premises.evidence_span: B-Block lets children learn the fundamentals of computer programming through game puzzles and helping them animate different game characters to perform certain tasks and movements.

premises.text: The app presents coding concepts in an easy and intuitive way
premises.evidence_span: which is primarily presumed as very complicated things in graphical programming blocks, which are very easy and intuitive to use.

premises.text: The app is designed to be colorful and attractive for children aged 7 to 13
premises.evidence_span: Our app is primarily built to look as colorful and as attractive as possible for kids 8, 7, and 13.

premises.text: The app allows for interactive learning through augmented reality
premises.evidence_span: it will be able to make the learning process much more interactive.

premises.text: B-Block is mobile-first and works offline, increasing accessibility
premises.evidence_span: B-Blocky is a mobile first as we are positioned to take advantage of this rapidly evolving technology where our application works fully offline.

premises.text: The app has a primary revenue source from in-app purchases
premises.evidence_span: Our primary source of revenue is in-app toy store where we allow our users to purchase different game characters in our toy store.

premises.text: Branded characters can provide additional revenue opportunities
premises.evidence_span: our other source of revenue is branded characters where companies and brands can feature their branded mascots or environment in our app.

premises.text: B-Block has been downloaded over 5,000 times without a marketing budget
premises.evidence_span: B-Blocky has been downloaded more than 5,000 times around the world and around the world with no marketing budget to it.

premises.text: The African gaming market is rapidly growing
premises.evidence_span: the African gaming market is doubling by 2021.

value.text: Children can learn coding in a fun and engaging way through B-Block
value.evidence_span: Programming has never been this easy and fun.

notes: No external knowledge or traction metrics were included.
